programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Tačnije, to on misli, jer poremećeni Žang ima sopstveni plan. Uslediće još veća erupcija krvi, prevara i nasilja.

programme.title: Njuškalo i lov na letećeg fantoma
programme.desc: Rat je završen i selom je zavladao mir. Ali onda, iznenada, tajanstvena prilika u crnom počinje da vreba seljane. Legenda kaže da se ponovo vratio Leteći fantom. Tom, njegova devojka Mirjam i Njuškalo kreću u istragu. Zahvaljujući Njuškalovim posebnim sposobnostima, fantom je uhvaćen u zamku, a zlokobna zavera ubistva i osvete otkrivena je baš na vreme!

programme.title: Loša genetika
programme.desc: Žena koja je ostavljena jedanaest puta, otkriva (na svoje zaprepašćenje) da ima gubitničke ljubavne gene.

programme.title: Vellčanstveni Ambersonovi
programme.desc: Razmaženo derište, Džordž Amberson, užasnut je kada njegova majka, odnedavno udovica, obnovi vezu s imućnim Judžinom Morganom, koga je ostavila nekoliko decenija ranije, kako bi se udala za Džordžovog oca. Dok se Džordž trudi da sabotira romansu svoje majke, mora se nositi ii sa sopstvenim osećanjima prema Morganovoj ćerci.

programme.title: Kralj boraca
programme.desc: Film akcije na osnovi priče iz video igre " Kralj ratnika"

programme.title: Čovek od poverenja
programme.desc: Priča o Beriju Monkovu, mladom harizmatičnom biznismenu koji postaje imućni direktor i stiže do samog vrha uz pomoć laži, prevara i krađe.

programme.title: Kamp snova
programme.desc: Devojka koja nema mnogo dodirnih tačaka sa sportom, Vitni Karmajkl, prijavljuje se u fizički veoma zahtevan letnji kamp kako bi unela promene u svoj život, ali se tamo zaljubljuje u svog trenera. Na svom putovanju pronalazi snagu da prihvati sebe onakvu kakva jeste i da se oslobodi tuđih očekivanja.

programme.title: Dženino venčanje
programme.desc: U gradiću u kom je rođena, niko ne shvata zašto se Dženi, najlepša i najpopularnija devojka iz kraja, još uvek nije udala. Kruže glasine da je ljubavnica oženjenog muškarca u "velikom gradu" u kom sada živi, zbog čega nikoga ne dovodi sa sobom na venčanje svog školskog druga. Njeni roditelji očajnički žele da se skrasi. Ipak, Dženina objava venčanja, kada do toga konačno dođe, nije ono što je bilo ko od njih očekivao.

programme.title: Istina o lažima
programme.desc: Gilbi se zatiče u zamršenoj mreži laži, jer je istinu preteško priznati, a još teže prihvatiti.

programme.title: Ljubavnica
programme.desc: Uverena da joj je muž možda živ, Se-jon posumnja u dadilju Jung-sim. Eun-su, uz Sun-hoovu karticu, prati očevu ljubavnicu, dok Hva-jong uznemirava žena bliska Te-ou. Da li je istina u koju su verovale zapravo bila laž?

programme.title: Sponzor
programme.desc: Kada muzičarka koja jedva sastavlja kraj s krajem ne može da plati kiriju, prijavljuje se na sajt na kojem bogati stariji muškarci plaćaju da izlaze s mlađim ženama. Novi izvor zarade uvlači je u mračni vrtlog koji je primorava da brzo odraste i menja njenu muziku i pogled na svet.

programme.title: Ekspres
programme.desc: Prati kriminalnu psihologinju Bárbáru i njenju porodicu nakon što postane žrtva jednog od najnovijih, viralno širenih oblika nasilnog zločina, brzih otmica.

programme.title: Someone Behind the Door
programme.desc: A neurosurgeon with a cheating wife takes an amnesiac into his home and conditions him to believe that the cheating wife is his own and to take the "appropriate" action.

programme.title: John Wayne Guns Along the Trail
programme.desc: John Wayne is back, doing what he does best _ slingin' guns and throwing fists in this action-packed tale of intrigue in the Wild West. John Wyatt (Wayne) is a government agent who must go undercover in a traveling medicine show to infiltrate a dangerous gang of counterfeiters. Guns Along the Trail has been beautifully restored and is in color for the very first time.

programme.title: The Stranger Within a Woman
programme.desc: Two friends meet in a bar. Later that night, one friend's flirtatious wife is reportedly in an accident. The other friend doesn't feel well. What's come over him?

programme.title: The Admiral Was a Lady
programme.desc: Ex-WAVE encounters four fun-loving, work-hating men, all of whom want to marry her.

programme.title: Night Light
programme.desc: A 14-year-old boy is about to go and live with his mother in the city. Before leaving his hometown, he has to confront his father's inability to give him an integrated family.

programme.title: The Navigator
programme.desc: The wealthy and impulsive Rollo Treadway decides to propose to his beautiful socialite neighbor, Betsy O'Brien. Although Betsy turns Rollo down, he still opts to go on the cruise that he intended as their honeymoon.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: Early in the War of 1812, Captain James Marshall is commissioned to run the British blockade and fetch an unofficial war loan from France. As first mate, Marshall recruits Ben Waldridge, a cashiered former British Navy captain. Waldridge brings his former gun crew...who begin plotting mutiny as soon as they learn there'll be gold aboard. The gold duly arrives, and with it Waldridge's former sweetheart Leslie, who's fond of a bit of gold herself. Which side is Waldridge really on?

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: Imprisoned for a murder he did not commit, John Brant escapes and ends up out west where, after giving the local lawmen the slip, he joins up with an outlaw gang. Brant finds out that 'Jones', one of the outlaws he has become friends with, committed the murder that Brant was sent up for, but has no knowledge that anyone was ever put in jail for his crime. Willing to forgive and forget, Brant doesn't realize that "Jones" has not only fallen for the same pretty shopgirl Brant has, but begins to suspect that Brant is not truly an outlaw.

programme.title: Dressed to Kill
programme.desc: A convicted thief in Dartmoor prison hides the location of the stolen Bank of England printing plates inside three music boxes. When the innocent purchasers of the boxes start to be murdered, Holmes and Watson investigate.

programme.title: Bulldog Drummond's Bride
programme.desc: Hugh "Bulldog" Drummond is on the precipice of matrimony to his beloved Phyllis -- but a bank robbery and a daring escape is going to get in their way before they reach the altar.

programme.title: Private Buckaroo
programme.desc: A rebellious young inductee has trouble toeing the line until he meets a retired officer's lovely daughter. James and his band are also drafted and decide to perk up their camp by putting on a big show.

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: A Confederate veteran living in the Yankee North struggles with his son's shock induced muteness and the hate of the Northerners.

programme.title: Champagne Safari
programme.desc: Travelogue/documentary follows newly married Rita Hayworth and Prince Aly Khan on their honeymoon trip through exotic locales.

programme.title: Call the Mesquiteers
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers are forced to track down a train robbery ring after some of the gang hijack their truck for a getaway and the police conclude they are part of the gang, an identification which is just fine with the gang's nameless chief.

programme.title: King of the Zombies
programme.desc: During World War II, a small plane somewhere over the Caribbean runs low on fuel and is blown off course by a storm. Guided by a faint radio signal, they crash-land on an island. The passenger, his manservant and the pilot take refuge in a mansion owned by a doctor. The quick-witted yet easily-frightened manservant soon becomes convinced the mansion is haunted by zombies and ghosts.

programme.title: Daughters, Wives and a Mother
programme.desc: Tashiro coincidentally meets his best friend Sugimoto in a bar very close to the apartment in which Sugimoto's wayward wife is found dead. Although Tashiro is not a suspect in the police investigation, he is racked with guilt and confesses to his wife, Masako. In an effort to further relieve his tortured sense of guilt, he then confesses to Sugimoto. Neither his wife nor his friend can believe that he could have been involved.

programme.title: The Trial
programme.desc: Josef K wakes up in the morning and finds the police in his room. They tell him that he is on trial but nobody tells him what he is accused of. In order to find out about the reason for this accusation and to protest his innocence, he tries to look behind the façade of the judicial system. But since this remains fruitless, there seems to be no chance for him to escape from this nightmare.

programme.title: The Monster Maker
programme.desc: Mad scientist injects his enemies with acromegaly virus, causing them to become hideously deformed.

programme.title: 'Neath the Arizona Skies
programme.desc: Chris Morrell, the guardian of half-Indian girl Nina, is helping her find her missing white father. so she can cash in on her late mother's oil lease. Outlaw Sam Black is after the girl and her father as well. Besides dealing with the Black gang, Morrell has to find another robber, Jim Moore, who switches clothes with him after he finds Chris unconscious from a fight with Sam Black. Along the way, he meets a lady who's the sister of Jim Moore, another bad hombre who's in cahoots with Jim Moore, and an old friend who takes in Nina and helps Chris locate Nina's father and fight off the various desperadoes

programme.title: Nancy Drew... Reporter
programme.desc: While participating in a contest at a local newspaper in which school children are asked to submit a news story, local attorney Carson Drew's daughter Nancy intercepts a real story assignment. She "covers" the inquest of the death of a woman who was poisoned. Nancy doesn't think the young woman accused of the crime is guilty and corrals her neighbor Ted into searching for a vital piece of evidence and stumbles onto the identity of the real killer.

programme.title: Nancy Drew... Reporter
programme.desc: While participating in a contest at a local newspaper in which school children are asked to submit a news story, local attorney Carson Drew's daughter Nancy intercepts a real story assignment. She "covers" the inquest of the death of a woman who was poisoned. Nancy doesn't think the young woman accused of the crime is guilty and corrals her neighbor Ted into searching for a vital piece of evidence and stumbles onto the identity of the real killer.

programme.title: Badge of Honor
programme.desc: Bob Gordon comes from a rich background but wants make it on his own. He dreams of becoming a newspaper reporter and he eventually gets his chance.

programme.title: Father
programme.desc: Mourning the death of her father, Giulia is contacted by him from the other dimension.

programme.title: Her Lonely Lane
programme.desc: Fumiko struggles to get her literary work published, spending years working in poverty while being abused by her boyfriend all the while hoping to break free from the cycle.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: Ted Hayden impersonates a wanted man and joins Gentry's gang only to learn later that Gentry was the one who killed his father. He saves Virginia Winters' dad's ranch from Gentry and also rescues his long-lost brother Spud.

programme.title: The Water
programme.desc: A man wakes up in a world where the water has disappeared. There's no water in the pipes nor in the bottles. Not even one drop falls from the clouds. The sea itself has become a desert. However, everyone acts as if nothing happened. In the bars they sip from empty glasses, from a springboard a diver falls into a dry pool. Alone, the protagonist realizes the incredible disappearance _ and nobody pays attention to him.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: Terror by Night
programme.desc: Holmes and Watson board a passenger train bound from London to Edinburgh, to guard the Star of Rhodesia, an enormous diamond worth a fortune belonging to an elderly woman of wealth; but within the first hour of the trip, the woman's son is murdered and the diamond stolen and any of the passengers in their car could be the killer thief.

programme.title: Suddenly
programme.desc: The tranquility of a small town is marred only by sheriff Tod Shaw's unsuccessful courtship of widow Ellen Benson, a pacifist who can't abide guns and those who use them. But violence descends on Ellen's household willy-nilly when the U.S. President passes through town... and slightly psycho hired assassin John Baron finds the Benson home ideal for an ambush.

programme.title: Jack London
programme.desc: Episodes in adventurous life of the American novelist.

programme.title: The End of Summer
programme.desc: The family of an older man who runs a small sake brewery become concerned with his finances and his health after they discover him visiting an old mistress from his youth.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious
programme.desc: A trucker framed for murder breaks out of jail, takes a young woman hostage, and enters her sports car in cross-border road race hoping to get to Mexico before the police catch him.

programme.title: Indiscreet
programme.desc: A young woman jeopardizes the relationship with the man she loves when a no-account from her past shows up.

programme.title: The Harvest
programme.desc: Thousands of foreign workers support today the most known Italian excellence: agri-food production. A docu-musical shows their daily exploitation.

programme.title: Captain Kidd
programme.desc: Cutthroat pirate William Kidd captures Admiral Blayne's treasure ship and hides the bounty in a cave. Three years later, Kidd, posing as a respectable merchant captain, offers his services to the King of England. Seeking a social position, Kidd also negotiates for Blayne's title and lands, provided he can prove Blayne was associated with piracy. Launched upon his royal mission, Kidd is unaware that Blayne's son Adam is among the crew, determined to clear his father's name.

programme.title: Career Girl
programme.desc: Joan Terry, a girl from the country wants to become a Broadway Star, but this proves to be not so easy.

programme.title: Go West
programme.desc: With little luck at keeping a job in the city a New Yorker tries work in the country and eventually finds his way leading a herd of cattle to the West Coast.

programme.title: A Midsummer Night's Dance
programme.desc: This is a wonderful story of a matchmaking event in Italy. Young men and women are escorted to a midsummer dance. There is a man who coordinates the proper arrangements and the mountain villages send their youth.

programme.title: The Waiting
programme.desc: Jean Barreau leads a spiritual commune on the countryside with the promise of a second life. When their doubles arrive at the house, his followers learn that Jean meant this promise quite literally. However, not everybody is as easily swayed by their capricious leader, who eventually starts to question his own beliefs.

programme.title: Mad Doctor of Blood Island
programme.desc: A man who loves to travel, travels to an island where a mad doctor is creating zombies.

programme.title: The Captive Heart
programme.desc: A series of stories about the lives and loves of nine men in a Prisoner of War Camp over five years. Location shooting in the British occupied part of Germany adds believability. The main story is of Hasek (Redgrave) a Czech soldier who needs to keep his identity a secret from the Nazis, to do this he poses as a dead English Officer and corresponds with the man's wife. Upon liberation they meet and decide to continue their lives together. The other inmates' stories are revealed episodically.

programme.title: The Captive Heart
programme.desc: A series of stories about the lives and loves of nine men in a Prisoner of War Camp over five years. Location shooting in the British occupied part of Germany adds believability. The main story is of Hasek (Redgrave) a Czech soldier who needs to keep his identity a secret from the Nazis, to do this he poses as a dead English Officer and corresponds with the man's wife. Upon liberation they meet and decide to continue their lives together. The other inmates' stories are revealed episodically.

programme.title: The Murder in the Museum
programme.desc: When a city councilman is murdered while investigating allegations of drug dealing going on a a somewhat disreputable sideshow, the daughter of the chief suspect teams up with a newspaper reporter to find the real killer.

programme.title: Life with Father
programme.desc: A financier from New York rules his numerous family, consisting of his wife and his four sons, with the meticulousness of a bookkeeper.

programme.title: Rain
programme.desc: Due to a possible cholera epidemic onboard, passengers on a ship are forced to disembark at Pago Pago, a small village on a Pacific island where it incessantly rains. Among the stranded passengers are Sadie Thompson, a prostitute, and Alfred Davidson, a fanatic missionary who will try to redeem her.

programme.title: Renegade Girl
programme.desc: Ann Shelby, whose family is allied with the notorious William Quantrill, turns outlaw to revenge herself on a renegade Indian who killed her brother.

programme.title: Frieda
programme.desc: A Royal Air Force pilot who was shot down during World War II returns home to his English village with his new bride. The trouble is that she is the German lady who helped him escape. Then her brother arrives.

programme.title: Please Murder Me
programme.desc: A lawyer tries to exact justice on a woman he defended in court -- a woman whom he found out was guilty after getting her off.

programme.title: The Lady Refuses
programme.desc: A wealthy London nobleman hires a pretty but poor young woman to distract his playboy son from marrying a golddigger. Complications ensue when the girl and the father begin to fall for each other, and things get even more complicated when the son declares his love for her, too.

programme.title: The Inspector General
programme.desc: An illiterate stooge in a traveling medicine show wanders into a strange town and is picked up on a vagrancy charge. The town's corrupt officials mistake him for the inspector general whom they think is traveling in disguise. Fearing he will discover they've been pocketing tax money, they make several bungled attempts to kill him.

programme.title: Scarlet Street
programme.desc: A banned box-office hit, Scarlet Street is one of Fritz Lang's greatest American films. Middle-aged cashier Chris Cross rescues streetwise Kitty and tumbles into a spiral of desire, deception, and revenge. As his obsession grows, Chris is seduced, degraded, and transformed, while fate delivers a grimly ironic justice. Featuring standout performances by Joan Bennett and Dan Duryea, the film is packed with sharp twists and masterful direction—a classic, pitch-dark gem of film noir.

programme.title: Our Daily Bread
programme.desc: John and Mary Sims are city-dwellers hit hard by the financial fist of The Depression. Driven by bravery (and sheer desperation) they flee to the country and, with the help of other workers, set up a farming community _ a socialist mini-society. The newborn community suffers many hardships _ drought, vicious raccoons and the long arm of the law _ but ultimately pull together to reach a bread-based Utopia.

programme.title: Corpse Vanishes
programme.desc: A scientist, aided by an old hag and her two sons, kills virginal brides, steals their bodies, and extracts gland fluid to keep his ancient wife alive and young.

programme.title: The Hoodlum
programme.desc: Vincent Lubeck is a vicious ex-convict. His criminal activities are despised by his family, but he uses and abuses them in the course of his crimes. Eventually his own brother must stand up to him

programme.title: The Tall T
programme.desc: An independent former ranch foreman is kidnapped along with an heiress, who is being held for ransom by trio of ruthless outlaws.

programme.title: Captain Calamity
programme.desc: A South Seas skipper fights off thieves and pirates who are after a lost treasure.

programme.title: John Wayne Cold Vengeance
programme.desc: John Wayne burns up the screen in this thrilling tale of vengeance in the Wild West. When his father is gunned down by bandits, John Mason (Wayne) hatches a plot to catch the killer. Little does he know the killer has plans of his own! Featuring a thrilling gun battle with famed Wayne collaborator Yakima Canutt, Cold Vengeance has been beautifully restored and is in color for the very first time.

programme.title: The Jungle Woman
programme.desc: When a treasure hunter seeks a downed airplane in the jungles of Africa, he encounters one of the passenger's young daughter, now fully grown, and with a gorilla protector.

programme.title: Dead Men Walk
programme.desc: The twin of a kindly small-town physician returns from the grave for vengeance against his brother, who secretly killed him because the twin served Satan.

programme.title: Fear and Desire
programme.desc: After their airplane crashes behind enemy lines, four soldiers must survive and try to find a way back to their battalion. However, when they come across a local peasant girl the horrors of war quickly become apparent.

programme.title: Izdaja
programme.desc: 40-godišnja Prisila Strol traži novi početak kada se ona i njen sin tinejdžer presele u mali grad u Kaliforniji, nesvesni da će to dovesti do njenog preranog kraja.

programme.title: Živeti sa 300 kg: Brazil
programme.desc: Andre je usamljeni čovek koji je veći deo svog života proveo pokušavajući da udovolji drugima. Gojaznost ga je ograničavala na mnogo načina.

programme.title: Hitna pomoć: Snimljeno kamerom
programme.desc: Ženi počinje porođaj, ali joj na porođajnom stolu staje srce. Rakuni upadaju u kuću, a ekstremni trening dovodi do poziva hitnoj službi.

programme.title: Stopala me ubijaju
programme.desc: Pacijenti dr Breda Šejfera i dr Eboni Vinsent podvrgavaju se operacijama da bi radikalno transformisali svoja stopala i zauvek promenili živote.

programme.title: Živeti sa 300 kg
programme.desc: Pratimo živote ljudi koji imaju preko 270 kg. Na njihovom jednogodišnjem putu, oni pokušavaju da izgube hiljade kilograma kolektivno, kako bi preživeli.

programme.title: Venčanica iz snova
programme.desc: Kejt je u salonu sa pratnjom u kojoj se nalazi njen otac; Lein tata ne može da prisustvuje jer je kvadriplegičar; Nensi je stigla sa svojim ocem koji prati modu radi izmena.

programme.title: Komšijska straža
programme.desc: Od neočekivanih neuspeha do dobrih namera koje krenu po zlu, život je najzabavniji kada ništa ne ide po planu.

programme.title: Komšijska straža
programme.desc: Džekson ide u posetu slepoj mački koja pati u haotičnom životnom okruženju. Onda upoznaje mačku, Džud, koja je tokom dana draga _ ali noću pretstavlja košmar.

programme.title: Komšijska straža
programme.desc: Džekson pomaže jednom paru koji se plaši da ima dete zbog svoje neprijateljske mačke, Martini. I može li da održi mir između mačaka Tane i Bude koje se bore oko legla mačića?

programme.title: Komšijska straža
programme.desc: Džekson pomaže mački Gud Kiti da se suprotstavi svojim mačjim napadačima. Takođe upoznaje par kojem je dosta njihovih mačaka, Tiki i Marli, koje jedu sve što im je na vidiku.

programme.title: Ljubav i prevod
programme.desc: Tri Amerikanca traže ljubav u vili na moru sa 12 žena. Začkoljica? Nijedna od njih ne govori engleski! Može li ljubav probiti jezičku barijeru?

programme.title: Neverstvo
programme.desc: Kako nipodaštavani ljubavnik reaguje kad se ispostavi da je njegov partner izdajnik? Ova serija rekonstruiše izdaje, tajne i laži koje parove dovode do raskida.

programme.title: Sestre od 500 kilograma
programme.desc: Poligamni način života Kodija Brauna, njegovih žena i njihovih 18 dece zajedno dok pokušavaju da se snađu u životu "normalne" porodice u Juti.

programme.title: Sve žene mog muža: Retrospektiva
programme.desc: Pogled na poligamistički način života Kodija Brauna, njegove četiri žene i njihovih ukupno 18 dece dok pokušavaju da vode život kao "normalna" porodica u Juti.

programme.title: Dvostruki životi žena iz predgrađa
programme.desc: Na prvi pogled, one su supruge, majke i komšinice iz predgrađa, ali to je samo pola priče. Iza zatvorenih vrata, ovih šest žena iz Sent Luisa u tajnosti zarađuje kreirajući provokativan sadržaj.

programme.title: Cimerke od 500 kilograma
programme.desc: Bazbijevi žele da svojim ćerkama pruže najbolji Božić. Međutim, kako njihovi planovi propadaju, Danijel se oseća loše. Hoće li doći do svoje tačke pucanja?

programme.title: Okruženi ćerkama
programme.desc: Kako petorke Bazbijevih izrastaju od beba u velike devojčice sve se menja. Danijel i Adam moraju da se izbore s različitim raspoloženjima, haosom, magijom i pet puta većim neredom!

programme.desc: Glumačka ekipa istražuje zašto su neki parovi odlučili da krenu svojim putem. Džoš otkriva pravi razlog zašto nije pozvao Natali u svoj dom.

programme.title: Smrt u raju, istinite priče
programme.desc: Glumačka ekipa se sprema da duboko istraži detalje otvorenog bračnog ugovora između Đina i Džesmin, a stvari između Meta i Đina postaju eksplozivne.

programme.title: Veridba od 90 dana: U inostranstvu
programme.desc: Muškarci i žene iz Amerike koji su se zaljubili u partnere iz dalekih zemalja putuju u zemlje svojih izabranika kako bi započeli svoj bračni život u inostranstvu. PREMIERE

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Alexander Graham Bell, inspired by a misunderstood German paper, aimed to send multiple tones through a wire—leading to the invention of the telephone. He discovered that voice vibrations vary electric current strength, enabling sound transmission. Though revolutionary, it took time for people to grasp its impact. Today, wireless calls dominate, yet still rely on Bell's principles. As tech evolves, we may soon see phoneless communication.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: Our cities are being attacked, overrun and overwhelmed with pests and invasive species bent on decimating our homes and threatening our well being. What happens if these urban invaders continue to expand their territory and occupy our safe haven? Is it just a matter of time before an emerging deadly disease carried by one of those urban invaders creates havoc in our big cities?

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Hoylake and investigate a building known as The Parade. Dating back to 1909, this once former school, still seems to have ghostly pupils and teachers taking class.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: Long-hidden secrets are revealed through the R.I.P. team's talents and unique experiences, including those thought to be lost forever.

programme.title: What In the World
programme.desc: Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: What In the World
programme.desc: Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore fire—a force both friend and foe. Mastered by humans hundreds of thousands of years ago, fire remains as inevitable as wind or rain, yet deadly when uncontrolled. Disasters can strike anywhere: from a Brussels department store to a Rhode Island nightclub where pyrotechnics killed 100 people. Firefighters still charge into danger, hauling hoses, scaling stairs with heavy tools, and lifting 35-foot ladders to save lives.

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ _ experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Knutsford and investigate a former Crown Court. Multiple people have been sentenced to death and life in prison, but will the team encounter any of its former inmates tonight?

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: The haunted Graffitti House dates from the Civil War and many of its previous residents still linger.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O'Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird's that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Dali the emperor tamarin is mysteriously going bald—on his back! Keepers suspect two mischievous monkey roommates. Meanwhile, Kristina attempts an eye ultrasound on dolphin Ulysses, needing patience and precision. And it's party time for Garoe the chimp, who celebrates his first birthday with a swinging cake surprise!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with _ especially on her Segway! And with a normal day including alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods _ you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too! When Loro Parque and their volunteers conduct one of their famous beach clean ups _ you won't believe what they unearth! Even better though, a turtle rescued last year with a fishing hook in its throat is being released back to its ocean home. Now that's a good day at the beach.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures

This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The mighty grizzly bear. The tiny powerful ant. The lunging inimitable crocodile. The indestructible rhino beetle. The hammering mantis shrimp. Which is the strongest of them all? Grizzly Bear _ North America's sub-alpine lands are ruled by its mightiest resident. Ants _ With 12,000+ species, ants are fierce, territorial defenders, dispatching intruders with ease. Crocodile _ Ancient rulers of rivers, crocodiles have the strongest bite force ever recorded. Rhino Beetle _ This forest dweller can lift 850 times its own weight. Mantis Shrimp _ With bizarre eyes and a punch as strong as a .22 bullet, it's a tiny powerhouse.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The explosive sprinting Cheetah. The mighty bounding kangaroo. The horned and leaping wildebeest. The powerful and sure footed horse. Or the quick footed pronghorn. Which is the fastest over land? Cheetah _ On Africa's savannahs, predator and prey race at breathtaking speeds. Pronghorn _ North America's fastest, it sustains 60 km/h and can reach nearly 100. Wildebeest _ Iconic endurance runners; calves walk within minutes and run within days. Kangaroo _ Australia's largest marsupial, alert and powerful, built for speed. Brumby _ Wild horses, symbols of strength and freedom, gallop unbridled across Australia.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Whale Sharks: Gentle Giants introduces us to this amazing creature through scientists who are racing against time to save the species. Utilizing space-age technology from NASA and the Hubble Telescope, researchers are able to identify, catalogue and track individual sharks. In Mexico and remote Western Australia, whale shark tourism has proven to be both a blessing and a curse, as more and more boats vie for fewer animals. The program also features the remarkable story of shark cowboys who captured and transported 4 live whale sharks (in customized jumbo jets) to the Georgia Aquarium in Atlanta.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Predator vs. prey: this episode explores three bird escape tactics—climbing flight, horizontal speed, and diving. These behaviors reflect the evolutionary arms race. Birds of prey captivate us, from the mighty eagle soaring over open spaces to the peregrine falcon, the fastest animal alive. Vultures, often seen as omens, strip carcasses clean to survive. Whether elegant hunters or grim scavengers, each raptor plays its part in the Race of Life, adapting to stay one step ahead.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Crocodiles, descended from reptiles 250 million years ago, lurk just beneath the waterline, striking fear into prey. Turtles, among the oldest reptiles, use their shells for protection and camouflage across land, freshwater, and sea. Snakes, from rattlesnakes to dwarf pipe snakes, share traits like legless bodies and lidless eyes, relying on sun for warmth. The king cobra's venom can kill an elephant. Lizards escape predators by shedding tails, which regrow differently. For reptiles, cold blood offers a survival edge in the Race of Life.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In the series pilot, host Jonathan Bird travels to the Bahamas, where diver interactions with Tiger sharks have become up close and personal. These large and dangerous animals are not only being hand-fed, but actually handled by divers. Jonathan learns how to flip a Tiger shark from experienced shark handlers. Next, Jonathan investigates the Crystal Cave of Abaco, Bahamas…considered the most highly-ornamented underwater cave in the world!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan travels to Iceland to investigate a giant crack in the ground filled with frigid runoff from melting glaciers. It's rumored to be the clearest water in the world. Next, he heads down to sunny Florida, not to dive a coral reef or a spectacular shipwreck, but to dive in shallow, murky water under a busy bridge. This secret spot is home to some of the ocean's most remarkable, and weird, animals.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Plastic, once accidental, is now essential—from machines to daily items. It began with explosive billiard balls and beetle poop, leading to Bakelite and later nylon. Nylon's popularity even sparked riots during WWII. But plastic's durability and oil-based origin raise environmental concerns. Now, bioplastics grown in microorganisms—and possibly plants—offer quirky, sustainable alternatives for the future.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Rubber was first used by South American tribes for waterproofing and bouncing balls. Westerners struggled with melting rubber until Charles Goodyear discovered vulcanization, making rubber durable. This sparked the rubber boom, enriching cities like Manaus. Britain broke Brazil's monopoly by smuggling seeds. Later, synthetic rubber and Kevlar were developed—Kevlar is so tough it can stop bullets. Rubber's journey is full of quirky discoveries.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Learn the secrets behind thermos' amazing technology! And they were the sweet candy pellets we loved as a kid, but did you know that Pez was created to help people stop smoking? And find out how a steamboat inspired Samuel Langhorne Clemens to change his name to Mark Twain!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's one of the world's most famous train stations _ Grand Central Terminal. We'll take you on a trip to reveal its many fascinating secrets! And if they are cleaned without water, how do clothes get spotless when they are dry cleaned?

programme.title: Inside Outer Space

This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The commercial space flight companies are edging closer and closer to flight readiness. Paying customers will soon be launching into space; tourists and their money is thought to be a major step forward into space and beyond. Blue Origin flight tests have been a great success and may launch commercial flights as soon as year's end. Virgin Galactic is also smashing mile stones towards flight certification. SpaceX and its Manned Dragon capsule in direct competition with Boeings moves closer to an ISS taxi service.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The ESA _ JAXA joint Bepi-Colombo Mission is moments away from launch. The target is Mercury which has been too long neglected; this mission will shed new light on this strange world of light and dark.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Chromatic adaptation lets humans perceive consistent colors despite changing light. Some animals change color using chromatophores—for camouflage or signaling. Pink isn't a real wavelength; our brains create it by blending light. Blue is rare in nature but appears through structural features in feathers and wings. Snow camouflage helps animals blend into winter landscapes using shades of white and gray.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: The Monty Hall Problem shows switching choices boosts winning odds. The Birthday Problem reveals how just 23 people can have a 50% chance of shared birthdays due to multiple pairings. Gambler's Ruin proves that in a fair game, the smaller bankroll loses over time. The Infinite Hotel Paradox explores the strange logic of infinity. The Locker Riddle uses factorization to reveal why only lockers with perfect square numbers stay open.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: This angry spirit doesn't like being dead and still considers himself the sole owner of lovely Oaklands Mansion.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O'Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird's that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Loro Parque, voted "World's Best Zoo" two years in a row, blends top-tier animal care with global conservation efforts. From thousands of species to multi-million-dollar research, its mission is clear: protect wildlife and inspire change. What began 45 years ago as one man's passion is now a global model of excellence in education, sustainability, and animal welfare.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Federica the turtle has arrived from Italy after a run in with a container ship. Loro Parque's offered to be her 'forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? You've heard of a fish out of water _ try a turtle!Esmeralda the iguana has a lumpy belly and Jorge the vet is worried. He's hoping it's a bounty of eggs but knows he shouldn't count his iguanas before they hatch. Its fingers crossed for some scaly babies!

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Fanged Spiders with their scurrying bites. The Scorpion with its deadly sting... A sinister cold bloodied crocodile. The hypnotizing venomous snake. Or the King of Beasts, the Lion? Which one is the most dangerous? Lion _ With golden fur and regal mane, the lion reigns as the 'King of Beasts'. Scorpions _ In scorched deserts, danger awakens after sunset. Spiders _ Masters of webs and venom, spiders haunt myth and imagination. Snakes _ Feared and revered, snakes symbolize power, death, and rebirth. Crocodile _ Ancient and deadly, crocodiles inspire fear and legend across the globe.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The charming kangaroo. The cuddly koala. The beautiful Butterfly. The cheerful clown fish. Or the endearing budgerigar _ which is the cutest of them all? Clownfish _ Tropical oceans shimmer with dazzling marine life like the vibrant clownfish. Kangaroo _ Australia's countryside pulses with thousands of bounding kangaroos. Monarch Butterfly _ Monarchs fill the skies, delicate and stunning in flight. Budgerigar _ Social and lively, wild budgies flock in hundreds across Australia. Koala _ Soft-furred and beloved, koalas are one of Australia's most iconic animals.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Sharks are BIG business in adrenaline eco-tourism. And some thrill seekers deliberately pursue close encounters with deadly sharks _ without the protection of a cage. The bigger and more dangerous the shark, the better. Shark advocates Dr. Erich Ritter and Chuck Anderson have grave reservations about how far we are willing to go for a thrill. And they have intimate knowledge of the subject. Both men were brutally attacked by bull sharks. Shark Divers also examines the controversy surrounding a handful of high-profile attacks in 2008, including the first shark tourist killed while on a shark excursion.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Predators use speed, teeth, poison, and trickery to survive, but prey animals have evolved fascinating defenses. While fleeing is common, others use deception and chemistry—camouflage, mimicry, and toxins. Insects mimic leaves, snakes play dead, fish fly, and toads have poisonous skin. Predator-prey dynamics form an evolutionary arms race, with each side adapting to outsmart the other. Defense mechanisms include claws, poison, camouflage, and foul sprays. From zebra patterns to spider silk, strong defenses are vital to winning the Race of Life.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Most sea creatures are predators, from tiny fish to giant squid. Built to hunt and survive, they've evolved into efficient underwater war machines. Stonefish lie in wait, disguised, while sharks, barracuda, and moray eels hunt with speed and precision. Reef fish must dodge lightning-fast barracuda and graceful but deadly moray eels. Lionfish use venomous spines, and stonefish can swallow prey whole. In the ocean's depths, survival is a constant battle—an underwater jungle of razor teeth and stealthy ambushes.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan joins an expedition to recruit a new Blue World camera operator in the form of a 1,000 pound Tiger shark! Working with experienced shark handlers, he puts a camera on the dorsal fin of the shark to see what it can film all by itself. But will Jonathan get his camera back? Next, he joins an experienced cave diver to explore a famous underwater cave in Northern Florida (USA).

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Cave diving is the most difficult and dangerous type of diving, so the training to become a certified cave diver is arduous. This episode documents Jonathan's actual cave training in the Bahamas and follows him as he learns how to dive safely in the overhead environment of a cave in an attempt to earn his full cave diver certification.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Canned food began with Napoleon's contest to preserve food, won by Appert's boiled, sealed bottles. The British later developed metal cans, though early ones exploded or caused illness. Can openers came 30 years later. Pasteur's germ theory explained spoilage. Pressure-cooking improved taste, and now, 'raddaperization'—zapping food—is the future. Canning evolved from battlefield necessity to high-tech preservation.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Medical history is full of odd cures—like bloodletting, which still helps in rare cases. Germs were once doubted until a doctor spotted bacteria between his teeth. Fleming later discovered antibiotics by accident. But now, "superbugs" threaten this miracle cure. Refrigeration, once deadly due to toxic gases, evolved thanks to pressure-cooking and may soon use sound waves. From leeches to lab breakthroughs, medicine keeps evolving—what's next?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's cheesy and and eaten all over the world! You'll learn how Dominick's pizza became Domino's pizza. And we all know how going to a circus wouldn't be complete without fluffy sweet cotton candy! We'll explain how this feathery goodness Spun to life! And all the spy action heroes use them, but where did the term gadget really come from?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Take a trip to the Jersey Shore and learn how one of its famous boardwalks helped to inspire the iconic board game of Monopoly. And how did a donkey and an elephant become associated with politics? Plus, what's the difference between top grain leather and full grain leather?

programme.desc: Carrion flowers like rafflesia arnoldii are rare, large, and foul-smelling, attracting flies for pollination. Pheromones are chemical signals used for mating, tracking, or alarms. Deimatic behavior startles predators with sudden displays, helping prey escape

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Saccadic eye masking helps the brain blur fast eye movements for clear vision. Plants move in response to stimuli for survival and reproduction. Perspective illusion uses geometry to create depth in art, a technique refined during the Renaissance.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: Their bodies have long turned to dust, but the spirits of the original owners who built Bellewood remain in charge and don't mind chasing out tresspassers.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We're exploring the other side New York state in Buffalo and Niagara. We'll take the oath of office like Teddy, at the Roosevelt inauguration site in Buffalo. Then, we'll take a tour of the Frank Lloyd Wright Martin house and learn about America's most celebrated architect. We get soaked on the Maid of the Mist at breathtaking Niagara Falls, and defend the walls at Fort Niagara.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We're shipping off to Belfast, Northern Ireland on today's episode. First, we'll gawk at the world's biggest Titanic museum. Then, we'll learn about the province's complicated history at the Ulster Museum. Finally, we get thrown in the slammer at the very creepy, Crumlin Road Jail.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: A snapshot of Seasons, how they work together and keep the globe in balance. Droughts are explored in terms of how we can predict them, proof our lives from them and collect data because of them. Hurricanes are explained, their power revealed and the measures that are used to help us survive their impact. Thunderstorms have a few stages of development that roll out in a particular order.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: How are Rainbows formed and what's their science? We look at the largest Hail ever recorded and explain why it comes in so many shapes and sizes. Global Warming is a big issue and topic, and we give a nutshell insight to its meaning and impact on many levels. Forecasting is key and crucial to living with nature and its weather, as it involves precision technologies and expertise. Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Running Southbound outside on Central Coast with a big Tyee Chinook Release finish North of Milbanke Sound!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Chennai, formerly known as Madras, can trace its roots back to a tiny fishing village. Bill explores the city's growth under the British East India Company, with visits to Fort St. George and the Fort Museum. We then travel to the nearby Sao Tome Basilica, the church and burial site of St. Thomas the Apostle. In Pondicherry, French influences can still be felt in the tree-lined streets, colonial mansions and cafés. Its beautiful setting on the Bay of Bengal makes Pondicherry a delightful place to spend the day. We also visit the ancient port city of Mahabalipuram, where the landscape is dominated by carved-stone architecture. The final highlight of our tour is the Descent of Ganga, which is the world's largest bas-relief carving.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: There is no city in India that is more British than Calcutta. The former capital of British India, Calcutta has gardens, buildings and museums to prove it. Throw away any ideas you have of this giant city and discover the treasures it holds.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This ancient ruined city, lost to history, was one of the most powerful in the world during its prime. The architectural sophistication and sheer size will amaze. Then Journeys heads out to the deep ocean for some big game fishing. Will we land the big one or return empty handed?

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: One of the 7 Natural Wonders of the World, Victoria Falls is an amazing spectacle that straddles the Zambia/Zimbabwe border. The force of the water is so intense that the water bouncing back creates a rainforest. Remarkably, the wildlife in the area is as abundant as the water going over the falls.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: The best footage, locations and personalities in mountainbiking.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: A group of international explorers for an adventure of Kayaking. A combination of canyoneering and kayaking.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: One hundred kilometres above the Earth's surface lies an invisible frontier: the edge of space. This is the Karman Line, the boundary between our planet's atmosphere and what lies beyond. What does it take to cross that line?

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Launching payloads into space is a very difficult task, historically rocket launches are the proverbial "swords into ploughshares" Missiles designed to carry atomic warheads now send satellites and probes into the solar system. Ironically it's one of the few exploits Mankind undertakes that doesn't occur in nature.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: If you have ever gone to a hockey game, or gone ice-skating, there is one revolutionary machine that helps keep the fun and action going! And that's all thanks to the Zamboni® Ice Resurfacing Machine. You'll learn how and why it was invented! And ever notice some pistachio nuts are red in color? We'll throw up the red flag and explain why the color is simply a cover up!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: If you ever go camping there is one thing you do not want to leave home without, the swiss army knife! We'll explain how it evolved into the most famous knife in the world and how the company's name got "Cut" together! And where did the term "cup of Joe" come from as well as the word java? And we all love a juicy hamburger, so where did these chopped meat patties come from?

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories
programme.desc: Water: H2O Stories is a 3x52 series revisiting the story of water on planet Earth and its disrupted course over time which has led to the 21st century biggest challenge.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Weather is universal and it's also Extra Terrestrial. Learn about space weather and how it can impact us on earth. Supercells are unique storms that scientists have learnt to measure into three types. Under the earth's crust, nature is extremely energetic, and we see this through the Volcano which acts as our eye into the forces beneath our feet. Learn about the purple buzzing glow called St Elmo's Fire, how it was named and were to look for it.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Bez brašna i pečenja, sa jakim ukusom kestena, čokolade, putera, kafe, pavlake i konjaka. Teletina će biti crvena i salata sa kozjim sirom. Svi vole francusku kuhinju, to je opšte poznato.

programme.title: Dejvid Roko: Domaći slatkiši
programme.desc: Poslednjih godina, mnogi su prestali da putuju, pa i Dejvid Roko. Njega i porodicu su hrana i kuvanje zbližili. Dejvid sada otvara svoj dom i poziva porodicu i prijatelje da podele svoju priču o tome šta hrana znači za njih.

programme.title: Rik Stajn: Mediteranski izleti
programme.desc: U Maroku, Rik uživa u kuskusu i isprobava tažine i čajeve od nane, koje pronalazi na bazarima. Rik sprema marokansko jelo kefta mkaouara (jednostavno jelo od luka, paradajza, kima i paprike, pečeno sa ljutkastim ćuftama i jajima).

programme.title: Novi Zeland sa Džimijem Doertijem
programme.desc: Džimi saznaje zašto su konji rase klajdsdejl i dalje poželjniji od traktora. Kasnije odlazi do jezera Elsmir u koje se ulivaju reke i iz kojeg Maori love jegulje koje dime i kasnije prodaju svuda po Novom Zelandu.

programme.title: Pecite sa Akisom
programme.desc: U 4. sezoni serije "Pecite sa Akisom", voljeni grčki kuvar Akis vraća se sa toplim i primamljivim receptima u kojima spaja grčko kulinarsko nasleđe sa međunarodnom inspiracijom, nudeći jednostavne tehnike i ukusne rezultate za kuvare svih nivoa.

programme.title: Nadijini prosti začini
programme.desc: U ovoj seriji Nadija demistifikuje kuvanje sa začinima, pokazujući kako se lako njima jelo uzdiže do izvanrednog. Sa samo osam začina ona stvara fina jela za svaku priliku. Videćemo i da se začini koriste ne samo zbog ukusa već i zbog mirisa i boje.

programme.title: Nadia Husein: Kuvaj jednom, jedi dvaput
programme.desc: U središtu Nadijine filozofije "kuvaj jednom, jedi dvaput" je genijalna formula ""manje rada za više rezultata", bilo pretvaranjem ostataka u nova jela, spremanjem hrane zamišljene tako da bude zamrznuta ili korišćenjem onog što se obično baca.

programme.title: Mišel Ru na reci: Temza
programme.desc: Isplovite opet sa kuvarom Mišelom Ruom dok crta kulinarsku mapu, prateći tok Temze. Od Batersija preko Griniča i Vindzora do Redinga, Mišel je ucrtao kurs za još jedan niz izvrsnih i ukusnih kuvarskih vratolomija.

programme.title: Markus Vering: Priče iz kulinarske bašte
programme.desc: Markus Vering istražuje nove mogućnosti na svom imanju u Saseksu. Putuje na imanje "The Newt" kako bi upoznao vrhunskog pčelara i na farmi gradi novi dom za svoje svinje.

programme.title: Gurmanski voz: Džonatan Pang
programme.desc: U Sidneju Džonatan preleće hidroavionom iznad prelepog Palm Springsa. Na zemlji, novinar uživa u opuštajućem životu na plaži i isprobava ukusan čileanski brancin u svetski poznatom restoranu "Kod Džona". Zatim posećuje restoran Majka Džonatana.

programme.title: Džejmi u Gruziji
programme.desc: Džejmi vas vodi na kulinarsko putovanje kroz Gruziju na raskrsnici Istoka i Zapada, istražujući pijace Tbilisija i živopisnu vinsku regiju Kahetija. Nakon što uči od lokalnih kuvara, on uživa u tradicionalnim jelima i u gozbi, a zatim kod kuće pravi pečenje nadahnuto viđenim.

programme.title: Pecite sa Akisom
programme.desc: Kuvar Akis Petretzikis vraća se sa 10 živopisnih epizoda mediteranskih gozbi i neodoljivih deserta. Od porodičnih pečenja do rashlađenih kolača i grčkih klasika, 5. sezona donosi jednostavne, ukusne recepte za svakodnevne obroke i posebna okupljanja.

programme.title: Pecite sa Akisom
programme.desc: Kuvar Akis Petretzikis vraća se sa 10 živopisnih epizoda mediteranskih gozbi i neodoljivih deserta. Od porodičnih pečenja do rashlađenih kolača i grčkih klasika, 5. sezona donosi jednostavne, ukusne recepte za svakodnevne obroke i posebna okupljanja.

programme.title: Najdžel Slejter: Bliski istok
programme.desc: Najdžel završava svoju turneju Iranom, istražujući tajne persijske kuhinje. U Teheranu otkriva da je, uprkos razvijanju restorana brze hrane, tradicionalna kuhinja ostala popularna. Potom bere nar i šafran.

programme.title: Gordon, Đino i Fred na putovanju
programme.desc: Tri kuvara su došla u Đinovu domovinu Italiju. Đinov najbolji prijatelj obnavlja svoje bračne zavete kroz četiri dana. Trojac ulazi u svoj kombi i kreću u potragu za sastojcima za jela kojima će nahraniti 50 gostiju.

programme.title: Džejmi: Sve za 20 minuta
programme.desc: Svako jelo u ovoj seriji snimljeno je u jednom kadru bez montaže, bez trikova, odvažni recepti u realnom vremenu u jednom neprekinutom kadru. Brza hrana u realnom vremenu, večera za 20 minuta ili manje tako da publika zaista može da poveruje.

programme.title: Mišel Ru na reci: Temza
programme.desc: Isplovite opet sa kuvarom Mišelom Ruom dok crta kulinarsku mapu, prateći tok Temze. Od Batersija preko Griniča i Vindzora do Redinga, Mišel je ucrtao kurs za još jedan niz izvrsnih i ukusnih kuvarskih vratolomija.

programme.title: Gurmanski voz: Džonatan Pang
programme.desc: Džonatan napokon ispunjava svoju staru želju da poseti Maču Pikču. Ali prvo Džonatan odlazi u Limu, gastronomski centar Južne Amerike, gde isprobava niz tradicionalnih jela i lokalnih obroka spremljenih na savremen način.

programme.title: Džejmijeva čudesna jela iz jednog tiganja
programme.desc: Džejmi počinje serijal pripremom ukusne testenine u tiganju, a zatim sledi jednostavna, aromatična pita od ribe. Za kraj, priprema neverovatno jagnjeće pečenje, i otkriva kako ubrzati pripremu pečenja.

programme.title: Džejmijeva čudesna jela iz jednog tiganja
programme.desc: Džejmi pravi tri jela za čiju pripremu je potreban samo jedan tiganj. Prvo, na meniju je brza, aromatična i ukusna čorba s nudlama. Zatim sledi domaći hleb iz tiganja. Za kraj pravi pitu od piletine i gljiva, otkrivajući trik za brzu pripremu testa.

programme.title: Donalovi brzi superobroci
programme.desc: U ovoj prazničnoj epizodi Donal Skijan će preneti svoje tajne za brze superobroke na vašu trpezu. Svaki recept uzima u obzir zauzetost u ovim posebnim prilikama. Ova jela su savršena za one prezauzete dane između Božića i Nove godine.

programme.title: Donalovi brzi superobroci
programme.desc: Serijal "Donalovi brzi superobroci" prikazaće kulinarske tehnike koje zahtevaju minimalan trud. Ovi recepti će vam pomoći da maksimalno iskoristite svaki trenutak proveden u kuhinji. Ove nedelje na meniju su ukusna jagnjetina, salata i krompir.

programme.title: Adam i Po: Malezija u Australiji - Ukusni australijski obroci
programme.desc: Da bi se pravilno upoznala neka kultura, potrebno je upoznati njenu hranu. Hrana neke države otkriva detalje o klimi, kreativnosti i duši. Ova kulinarska avantura počinje na vrhu jedne od najzanimljivijih država na svetu.

programme.title: Adam i Po: Malezija u Australiji - Ukusni australijski obroci
programme.desc: Ova epizoda istražuje sastojke australijske kuhinje. Kombinacija starosedelaca, multikulturalizma i paba, jednog od najvećih nasleđa Velike Britanije.
